claim_boundary.supports: Seven hash-pinned public fixture workflows across five source families, eight checked-in or derived-format fixtures, and five generated parser/placement contracts completed the scan, preview, validate, and apply command lifecycle in separate evidence layers. Public fixtures also matched pinned sampling, channel/type/unit, sample/event, and import-warning facts. The fixed 11-case reviewed-choice set preserved its explicit choices and required evidence tiers.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: A passing lifecycle does not prove arbitrary files, scientific class semantics, full BIDS compliance, or source diversity for A01T-derived format conversions. Generated CSV, TSV, and TXT fixtures prove only the declared parser and placement contracts; they do not add public dataset-source diversity or certify arbitrary carrier schemas. SCCN rt/square and CNT marker evidence is IO/epoch only, not protocol-grounded supervised-class or training evidence.

current_truth.checked_in_depth: the matrix directly proves checked-in Graz scan, preview, validate, apply, and reviewed MAT label application; dataset generation and training remain separate integration evidence
current_truth.cross_source_breadth: 7 public cases from 5 source families completed scan, preview, validate, and apply
current_truth.main_limit: public fixtures remain local-only downloads; generated CSV/TSV/TXT cases prove parser and placement contracts but are deliberately excluded from public dataset-source diversity
